findings.specText: story-109 Pair resolution: "resolve the pair at call time via IUniswapV2Factory(router.factory()).getPair(sUSDS, phUSD), and revert with a custom error if it is zero. Two reasons. First, it stops Router02.addLiquidity from silently creating the pair before story 103's cutover seeds it at the intended price." story-111 Background: "The mainnet phUSD/sUSDS V2 pair ... stays that way until story 103's cutover is broadcast at Stage 4 ... Until then, swaps and liquidity operations through it revert."
findings.specSource: story-109 doc (Technical Details: Pair resolution); story-111 doc (Background); docs/UniswapHelperMainnetDeploy.md:7-15
findings.actualBehavior: The guard is existence-only: `p = pair(); if (p == address(0)) revert PairNotFound();` (UniswapHelper.sol:428-431). It blocks pair CREATION through the helper, as specified, but not the case the story's own rationale exists to prevent: a first-LP add into a pair that EXISTS but is still empty. The pair exists from cutover step 1 (UniPoolerCutoverCore.sol:327-333), and at any earlier time if anyone calls the permissionless factory.createPair. The runbook says the pair 'does not exist on mainnet until story 103's cutover is broadcast at Stage 4' (docs/UniswapHelperMainnetDeploy.md:8-9), which is not guaranteed.
findings.deviation: The implementation satisfies the letter of story 109 but not its stated safety purpose. Seeding before 103's cutover is still possible once the pair exists. Any helper add then gives the pair non-zero reserves, which permanently fails core step 2 (UniPoolerCutoverCore.sol:339/344) and the escrow's PairNotEmpty. Because of yield-claim-nft:051's canonical-pair constructor, no alternative pair can be used. Law 1 overrides: the spec as written ships an honest-user (non-adversarial) path to the same brick as ledger 9a694ae01fe1 / ycn L-26.
findings.securityImpact: Liveness. The Balancexit cutover design is bricked and the first LP sets the price. No direct theft. Refines CODE-005; do not double-file. It also strengthens 9a694ae01fe1 (pps39 L-01): the runbook's mitigation 'UI must not offer the mainnet Market tab yet' covers the UI but not direct calls.
findings.suggestedFix: In _addLiquidity paths, revert when either reserve is 0 (EmptyPair). Correct the runbook and story-111 wording to 'the pair may exist before Stage 4 (createPair is permissionless); the helper refuses to be the first LP'.

Plan §4 Stage 2 (docs/BalancerWinddownPlan.md:433): "Minimum viable fallback ... The BPT can still be recovered through removeLiquidityRecovery, and step 5 already allows for that." story-103 Technical Details (L162): "Case 2 runs the recovery-exit path. findings.specSource: story-100 doc; story-103 doc; src/docs/BalancerWinddownPlan.md L38, L433
findings.actualBehavior: The mock, as story 100 specified, makes 'paused' imply 'recovery allowed': `require(poolPaused, "MockBalancerVault: pool not in recovery mode")` (MockBalancerVault.sol:243). test/UniPoolerCutoverCore.t.sol:313 'proves' RECOVERY with `bVault.setPoolPaused(true)`. On mainnet a paused V3 pool is not in Recovery Mode until someone calls Vault.enableRecoveryMode(pool); per CODE-004, isPoolInRecoveryMode is false today. No story step and no core step calls it (UniPoolerCutoverCore.sol:384-386), and the escrow has no such step either. Story 100's own Decision 4 recorded that the live pool reverts PoolNotInRecoveryMode, yet the spec kept the conflation.
findings.deviation: The plan's fallback claim that 'step 5 already allows for that' does not hold as implemented, and story 103's recommended fork-test approach (mock the pause query) would reproduce the same conflation instead of catching it. The yield-claim-nft escrow fork test does call enableRecoveryMode (UniPoolerCutoverEscrow.fork.t.sol L216), so the correct pattern exists.
findings.securityImpact: Liveness only, fail-closed. After 30 Oct a RECOVERY_EXIT=true run reverts in simulation unless an operator enables recovery mode first, at the deadline-pressured moment. Plan §Summary says Balancer will enable Recovery Mode 'where needed', which may moot it. Refines CODE-004 at the spec level; merge with it at dedup.
findings.obligationFor: story-103: add 'if !vault.isPoolInRecoveryMode(pool) then vault.enableRecoveryMode(pool)' before the RECOVERY exit (or a step-0 require), and make fork case 2 use the real enableRecoveryMode rather than a mocked pause query.
